2: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A psalm of Asaph. A song. God is known in Judah. His name is great in Israel.
3: His den has been in Salem, his lair in Zion.
4: There he broke the flames of the bow, the shield and sword and battle. Selah
5: Radiant you are, majestic, from the mountains of prey.
6: The stouthearted are plundered; they sleep their sleep, and all the able men cannot ⌞use⌟ their hands.
7: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both rider and horse slumber.
8: ⌞You, indeed, are to be feared⌟, and who can stand before you when you are angry?
9: From heaven you proclaimed judgment. The earth feared and was still
10: when God rose for justice, to save all the afflicted of the land. Selah
11: For the anger of humankind will praise you. You will put on the remnant of anger.
12: Make vows and fulfill them to Yahweh, your God; let all surrounding him bring tribute to the one to be feared.
13: He cuts off the spirit of leaders. He is to be feared by the kings of the earth.
